newsitem.title: UK: CIBC unveils senior FX appointments.
newsitem.headline: CIBC unveils senior FX appointments.

text.p: CIBC Wood Gundy announced Michael Horrocks would head its global FX trading and sales operations, as part of a string of senior internal appointments in its global foreign exchange operations.
Karl Berger, who currently heads North American currency trading, will take the lead for all Canadian and non-Canadian dollar FX liabilities in North America, CIBC said.
Craig Ellis will relocate from Calgary to head up North American FX sales from Toronto and while in London, Cliff Symes will assume responsibility for all FX trading and sales.
Symes currently heads the proprietary trading desk, specialising in foreign exchange.
Berger, Ellis and Symes will report directly to Horrocks, as will Lee Boon Huat, who will continue to lead Asian FX operations, CIBC said.
